method: EXHAUSTIVE PER-LINE (docs/AUDIT_BRIEF.md): one clip at a time; read dossier, every emitter (literal and dynamic), lookup, reachability and gates; cooldown from dump; mods from modded_lines.json and the installed pitstop_failures build (1.1.4-rc.1).

Number hits in the dossier's other_functions are not emitters.

rows.situation: Player has a stop-go penalty pending (jump start, speeding in the pit lane, cut track, or ignored blue flag in a race, each only when the penalties-enabled global dword_7CEF84 is set). When the penalty counter reads 1 at timing split 2 of a lap, the game plays 'Pit this lap for Stop-Go' (player only, race phase != 8).
rows.twin_contradiction: TV eid 364 is a track-name table value (Hockenheim); dump maps 364 to PWS_PIT14. Same TV collision (UNKNOWN which wins).
rows.call_path: TimerFrameRateThrottle (0x4D3740 l.7) -> LapSplitTimeEvent (0x4BC390 l.51) -> LapCompletion (0x4BC4E0 l.197-211, a4 == 2) -> AISessionEventAudio (0x41A8C0 l.211). Counter source: sub_4BCCC0 l.117/184/379 or sub_4BC9B0 l.51 -> StopGoPenaltyHandler (0x4BBD60 l.41 ProgressBarEventEncode type 23) -> BufferReset (l.12) -> sub_4B3400 case 23 (l.230-231) -> AccumulatorWithFixedArray (0x4BBED0, sets counter to 3).
gates: AISessionEventAudio l.5-8: dword_7D0308 && flt_7CF3C8 != 0 && player (dword_7C54E8+18580 == a1+18580) && dword_7C56A8 != 8
LapCompletion l.197 a4 == 2 (split 2); l.204-207 loop finds a stop-go entry with value 1 (this[16+2k] == 1)
Counter is set to 3 when a stop-go is recorded (AccumulatorWithFixedArray) and decremented each race lap-line (LapCompletion case 7, l.125; loop at LABEL_28 l.138)

Stop-go sources (all need dword_7CEF84 PenaltiesEnabled, read at 0x007CEF84): sub_4BCCC0 l.117 (speeding in pit lane, race), l.181-184 (cut track, race), l.377-379 (ignored blue flag at 30 s); sub_4BC9B0 l.48-51 (jump start, car flag 3247 != 1)
sub_4BCCC0 is player-only: MainGameTickUpdate l.86-87 calls it only when player (dword_7C54E8) +13000 == 0

rows.situation: Not played. No native emitter in the corpus; no first-party mod plays the vanilla clip (MF uses eid 58 as a radio token, plays its own WAV; token_only, does not count).
rows.suppressed_note: No native trigger in code for eid 58 (teammate-pit state is not read by any native emitter). Not a suppression case.
rows.twin_contradiction: Dump maps TV eid 366 to PWS_TEAMPIT01. Same TV track-name collision (UNKNOWN).
rows.call_path: No native caller: eid 58 is not a literal or dynamic value in any of the 40 emitter functions.
rows.mod: mechanical_failures 1.0.7 (token_only, dll/mf_voice.h:81, MF_FUELLEAK02 'Fuel leak, box now.'). Vanilla clip never plays from MF. Pitstop does not use 58.
rows.heard_evidence: TRIAGE_NOTES.txt:39 (sdt 57): owner's trigger note ('team mate has pit order active AND player about to pit within one lap'). No log or heard evidence.
rows.notes: Owner's clip text ('Teammate pits this lap - stay out') and TRIAGE note agree. Census note 'SDT remap / donor row rewritten' for MF is stale: coordinator rule (b) says MF never rewrites event rows.

play_plan.meaning: Your team-mate is coming in for a stop on this lap, so you should stay out this lap and not compete for the pit lane or the box. Real-F1 term: the team holds the second car out while the other car's stop is in progress.
play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race only (SessionType 7). The player is on track with a stop planned for the next lap (or the player requested a stop), and the team-mate is in-lap or in the pit lane. Once per team-mate stop. Subject: team.
play_plan.trigger: player veh+0x3450 == 0 (track; CONFIRMED enum) AND player stop pending within the next lap: veh+0x342C > 0 and veh+0x3430+8i equal to lapNumber+1 (DERIVED; player side UNKNOWN) AND a team-mate with veh+0x48A0 equal to the player's and veh+0x489C different has veh+0x3450 == 1 (CONFIRMED enum) and the edge 0->1 is new this lap.
play_plan.subject: team (veh+0x48A0 constructor index; the native DriverDataTable call also passes this value for AIVehicleDamageEvent, findings f1c-veh-48a0-is-constructor-index)
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (ERE queues PWS eid 58; no native emitter, so the eid is free apart from MF tokens)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per team-mate stop (latch on the team-mate's 0->1 edge); never on the same lap as TEAMPIT02 (eid 59)
play_plan.must_not_play_when: SessionType != 7; player already in lane/box (pittingStatus 2-4); team-mate missing or on another constructor; a second driver with the same veh+0x48A0 is a different team (uniqueness across running cars UNKNOWN: prove before shipping); MF has an eid 58 line pending (DD-07)
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 token eid 58 (mf_voice.h:81): do not queue while an MF line is pending on 58 (DD-07; coordinator rule b). TEAMPIT02 (eid 59) on the same lap: never both. Pitstop does not use 58.
play_plan.calibration: Lap window that counts as 'within one lap' (1 lap assumed) and the player's stop-pending flag (no CONFIRMED locator; veh+0x342C/0x3430 DERIVED, player UNKNOWN). Team-mate pit timing measured live.
play_plan.live_test: 1) Race with a same-constructor team-mate. 2) Request a stop for the player on lap N. 3) Let the team-mate enter the pit lane first (pittingStatus 1) on lap N. Expect one 'Teammate pits this lap - stay out' before the player's stop lap. Read veh+0x3450 of both cars with f1c-memory to confirm the edge.
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED. Team-mate read is CONFIRMED (veh+0x3450, veh+0x48A0). The player's pit-order predicate is ERE-proposed (no native flag proven). Raise to CONFIRMED with a proven player stop-pending flag and team-index uniqueness.

play_plan.when_it_should_play: Race only (SessionType 7). The player has a stop planned (or is in-lap) and the team-mate is in the pit lane or box (in-lap is not enough). Once per team-mate stop, and not on the same lap as TEAMPIT01 (eid 58). Subject: team.
play_plan.trigger: player veh+0x3450 in {0, 1} (track or in-lap; CONFIRMED enum) AND (player stop planned: veh+0x342C > 0 (DERIVED, player side UNKNOWN) OR veh+0x3450 == 1) AND a team-mate with veh+0x48A0 equal and veh+0x489C different has veh+0x3450 in {2, 3} (CONFIRMED enum) for the first time this stop.
play_plan.subject: team (veh+0x48A0 constructor index; see TEAMPIT01 note)
play_plan.technique: own_emitter (ERE queues PWS eid 59; no native emitter)
play_plan.latch_cooldown: once per team-mate stop (latch on the team-mate's entry to 2 or 3); never on the same lap as TEAMPIT01
play_plan.must_not_play_when: SessionType != 7; player in lane/box (2-4) already; team-mate on the same constructor index but not a team-mate (uniqueness UNKNOWN); MF has an eid 59 line pending (DD-07); the player has no stop planned and is not in-lap
play_plan.conflicts: MF 1.0.7 token eid 59 (mf_voice.h:82, MF_CRIT01): do not queue while an MF line is pending on 59 (DD-07; coordinator rule b). TEAMPIT01 on the same lap: never both.
play_plan.calibration: Definition of 'pit order active' (no CONFIRMED player flag) and the team-mate in-pit threshold (2 or 3 assumed). Measure live.

Expect one 'Player can now pit' when the team-mate reaches the box. Confirm the text/note mismatch with the owner before the live test.
play_plan.confidence: DERIVED. Team-mate state reads are CONFIRMED; the 'pit order active' predicate is ERE-proposed (GUESS-level until a native player flag is proven); the wording mismatch with the TRIAGE note is open.
